summary: Atrium Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing a definitive securities purchase agreement with accredited PIPE investors for 5,170,384 common shares at $7.93 per share plus pre-funded warrants for 1,134,930 shares at $7.929 each, a $0.001 exercise price, raising roughly $50 million gross before fees. Leerink Partners is lead placement agent alongside Cantor Fitzgerald, Barclays, and Wells Fargo. Closing is expected on or about October 9, 2026, subject to customary conditions; warrants carry a 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership blocker, adjustable up to 19.99% on 61 days' notice. Watch dilution, warrant overhang, and pricing versus market.
